title: The Decision
shot: medium, then wide toward the exit
camera: medium three-quarter, then a slow pull back as he turns to the passage
action: KAIRO carefully lifts the circular map, studies the glowing point, and turns toward the cave exit with a determined expression.
lighting: map glow under his chin, cold cave light behind
audio: cloth and stone, a single low string note of resolve, footsteps starting
dialogue_fa: نمی‌دونستم اون نقطه کجاست... یا قراره چه بلایی سرم بیاد. ولی یه چیزی رو می‌دونستم؛ باید دنبالش می‌رفتم.
gloss_en: I didn't know where that point was... or what was going to happen to me. But one thing I did know: I had to go after it.
continuity: map carried in both hands, glowing point facing up
passage mouth at frame-right for the exit
transition: he walks into the passage light; hard cut on a beat of silence to the present
image_prompt: Medium three-quarter shot of KAIRO the stickman in a hide tunic holding a circular amber stone tablet in both hands. The single golden-blue point on the tablet glows up onto his face and chest. He is already turning toward a dark passage mouth at the right of frame, spear tucked under one arm, jaw set. 2D cinematic animation, warm glow against cold cave.
video_prompt: KAIRO lifts the tablet carefully from the platform, studies the glowing point, then turns his body toward the exit passage. Camera pulls back slowly as he starts walking, the map light swinging across the cave walls. His expression settles into determination.
